text:
ana: Quick sync — we need to lock the enterprise POC timeline and owners for the Acme corp trial. Goal is end-to-end demo with SSO + file connector + perf targets by next Friday.

mike: Sounds good. I'm owner for the file connector integration. ETA Wed for initial connector + manifest.

jyoti: I'll own SSO + SCIM. Plan is basic SAML in test env by Tue, full SCIM push by Thu. Need help with PKI certs from infra.

ana: @ana (typo) — sorry, meant to ping @devops-bot to confirm cert provisioning ETA.

devops-bot: devops-bot: cert-request #ACME-POC created — estimated ready time 1759994360. Link: https://pager.example/ACME-POC

ana: small correction: demo must show embedding search + reranking using customer's docs, success criteria: 95% accuracy on sample eval set and median 150ms generation latency on 16-token tail.

mike: noted re: evals. I'll ship data extractor and example dataset by Wed EOD. Who runs the eval?

jyoti: I can run the eval once SSO + data access are attached. Also need model pinning guidance — should we use the quantized Llama-variant? @ana?

ana: Yes — use rwd-q4f14 (verified perf profile). Product wants deterministic rerank for scoring, so pin to that. Add a fallback to rwd-8bit if GPU memory shortage.

claire: I'll handle observability dashboard and alerts. Need the metric names: "poc.latency.median", "poc.embedding.similarity.avg", "poc.errors.rate". I'll create the dashboard and share a link.

mike: For integration deliverables checklist (my list): 
- file connector (owner: mike) — sample ingest script, schema mapping, ingest logs
- model config + rollout policy (owner: ana) — model pins, fallback mapping
- eval prompts + scripts (owner: jyoti) — dataset + score script (pytest harness)
- SSO/SCIM (owner: jyoti) — test idp + provisioning
- observability (owner: claire) — dashboard + alerts
- infra/PKI (owner: infra) — cert + k8s secret

ana: I'm adding a success checklist too: 
- demo queries pass: relevant results in top 3 for 8/10 cases
- end-to-end latency below 200ms median in demo env
- audit log shows no PII leakage for sample corpus
- SSO login for two pilot users works

jyoti: Dependency note: the file connector needs the svc account created in k8s (namespace: acme-poc). @devops-bot said cert ready at 1759994360 — please open the service account early.

devops-bot: k8s-sa acme-poc-svc created at 1759994372. Secrets: acme-poc-cert created at 1759994373.

mike: I pushed a tiny PR for the connector: https://github.com/redwood/ingest/pull/842 — needs one review from eng-plat. Pinged @claire for the observability labels to attach.

claire: Reviewing now, will add label mappings (team: sales-poc) and push a follow-up commit.

ana: Can we confirm who will run the demo on the call next Friday? I can present product flow; need someone to answer infra/model questions.

jyoti: I can be on the call for SSO and evals. Mike can handle ingestion/model.

mike: Yep I can do model/ingest.

ana: Great. Final: owners set, certs + SA created, PR open. Next sync async updates here — please drop quick thumbs when your item is done. :thumbsup:

claire: :thumbsup:

mike: :thumbsup:

ana: Thanks everyone — tagging the timeline: milestone = demo-ready by 1759994860 (next Friday 9am PT).
